Why Prosperity Life School

Earning Money Is Only One Part of Financial Success.

Many people work hard for decades but still are not completely clear about the questions on the right. Prosperity Life School exists to bridge this gap. We combine financial education, practical implementation, professional guidance and accountability so that financial knowledge turns into meaningful action.

Knowledge creates awareness. Implementation creates transformation.

Our core philosophy

The 3M Model

Three ideas that work together: how you think about money, how you manage it, and how you grow what comes in.

01

Millionaire Mindset

Develop the beliefs, habits and decision-making skills required to build long-term prosperity.

02

Money Management

Learn to manage cash flow, debt, protection, investments, retirement, taxation and succession systematically.

03

Multiple Sources of Income

Discover and develop additional income opportunities based on your skills, experience and financial goals.

Income→Foundation→Corpus→Legacy

Our goal is not simply to help you earn more. It is to help you build a financial life that supports freedom, security, choice and legacy.

Retirement planning

Don’t Leave Your Retirement Number to Guesswork.

Retirement planning is not simply about accumulating investments. It is about knowing how much you may need, whether your existing resources are on track, how income may be generated after retirement, and how inflation and unexpected expenses can affect your corpus.

1Know how much you may need
2Check whether your resources are on track
3Plan how income may be generated after retirement
Calculate Your Retirement Readiness

Meet your mentor

Dr Maria Pramila Dsouza

Chartered Wealth Manager & Prosperity Mentor

From a government school teacher to a financial educator and wealth professional, Dr Maria’s journey has been driven by one mission: to make practical financial education understandable, actionable and accessible to families.

Her approach combines financial education with practical implementation across money management, protection, investing, retirement, income creation and legacy planning. She is the founder of Prosperity Life School, an ecosystem designed to help people move from financial confusion towards greater clarity, confidence and financial capability.

  • PhD in Finance and Chartered Wealth Manager
  • Creator of the GEM Framework: Grow Awareness, Elevate Wealth, Master Life Skills
  • Guides families in India and the Gulf
  • Teaches in English, Kannada, Tulu and Konkani
15+years in personal finance
12,000+people educated
500+client families
